name: GLOW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own top title, defended twice in a matter of weeks against three separate challengers without changing hands.

name: GLOW Northeast Championship
epitaph: A regional secondary title whose holder weathered a string of number-one contenders across the promotion's early summer.

name: GLOW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own tag-team title, held into midyear behind a manager who ran interference on its champions' behalf.
